answer: Each identity carries a lantern dimming every idle epoch; 100 clones cost $24,000. Verified work earns 25 points an epoch, idle epochs dim it, and 100 points reaches the ledge of attestation. Clones on one funding trail share one dimming curve; one failed audit dims them all. At each dawn auditors sample 10% of identities; a caught clone loses light, weight, trail for 10 epochs. An honest agent pays $120 for four $30 epochs; 100 clones pay $12,000, and two failed audits at $6,000 each make $24,000, twice as much. A clone farm is a sandcastle at high tide, rebuilt twice as fast.
